channelUrls.title: Channel URLs
channelUrls.description: YouTube channel URLs, handles (@username), or channel IDs (UCxxx). Accepts any format.

maxVideos.title: Max Videos Per Channel
maxVideos.description: Maximum number of videos to scrape per channel. Set to 0 to get only channel info without videos.

sortVideosBy.title: Sort Videos By
sortVideosBy.description: How to sort the channel's video listings. If YouTube does not offer the chosen sort for a channel, newest-first is used.

sortShortsBy.title: Sort Shorts By
sortShortsBy.description: How to sort the channel's Shorts listing (when includeShorts is enabled). Falls back to newest-first when the channel offers no Shorts sort.

includeAbout.title: Include About Page Data
includeAbout.description: Extract total views, join date, location, country, and external links from the channel About page.

includeShorts.title: Include Channel Shorts
includeShorts.description: Scrape the channel Shorts tab and include Shorts in the output.

maxShorts.title: Max Shorts
maxShorts.description: Maximum number of Shorts to return (when includeShorts is enabled).

includeLiveVideos.title: Include Live/Stream Videos
includeLiveVideos.description: Scrape the channel Live/Streams tab and include live, upcoming, and past streams.

maxLiveVideos.title: Max Live Videos
maxLiveVideos.description: Maximum live/stream videos to return (when includeLiveVideos is enabled).

includePlaylists.title: Include Channel Playlists
includePlaylists.description: Scrape the channel Playlists tab and include playlist metadata in the output.

maxPlaylists.title: Max Playlists
maxPlaylists.description: Maximum number of playlists to scrape (when includePlaylists is enabled).

includePodcasts.title: Include Podcast Shows
includePodcasts.description: Scrape the channel Podcasts tab and include podcast shows (when the channel has one).

maxPodcasts.title: Max Podcast Shows
maxPodcasts.description: Maximum number of podcast shows to return (when includePodcasts is enabled).

includeCourses.title: Include Courses
includeCourses.description: Scrape the channel Courses tab and include course playlists (when the channel has one).

maxCourses.title: Max Courses
maxCourses.description: Maximum number of courses to return (when includeCourses is enabled).

includeReleases.title: Include Music Releases
includeReleases.description: Scrape the channel Releases tab and include release playlists (when the channel has one).

maxReleases.title: Max Releases
maxReleases.description: Maximum number of releases to return (when includeReleases is enabled).

includeMembersOnly.title: Include Members-Only Videos
includeMembersOnly.description: Also list members-only videos (titles and public metadata) when YouTube offers the Members-only filter for this channel. Rows carry isMembersOnly and are added in addition to maxVideos. Playback still requires the membership.

includeExactMetrics.title: Fetch Exact Video Metrics
includeExactMetrics.description: Also fetch each video's exact view and like counts, duration, publish date, category, and description. Turn off for faster, cheaper runs with listing-page values only.

market.title: Market / Region
market.description: Country used for regional content availability and localized results (YouTube gl parameter).

language.title: Language
language.description: Language for YouTube's interface text (relative dates like "2 days ago"). Titles and descriptions stay in the creator's own language.
